title: 第7章 赚钱的门路第8章 想致富先练丹
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 茅屋内，油灯微弱的光线照射在姚德龙那枯瘦的脸庞，一丝决然和兴奋在脸上交织。
40点阴阳值，是昨夜那场疯狂后系统奖励剩余的点数，是他翻身的本钱！
“舍不得孩子套不着狼？老子两辈子就没当过狼！”
他心中低吼，意念疯狂点向系统面板！
“系统！
给我提升！
《五行基础剑诀》！
《丹经·第一卷》！
统统圆满！”
消耗12点阴阳值！
【《五行基础剑诀》（黄阶中品）提升至：圆满！
消耗15点阴阳值！
【《丹经·第一卷》（黄阶上品）提升至：圆满！
两道璀璨夺目的符文，凭空凝结，带着一股玄奥难以言喻的气息，猛的飞入姚德龙的眉心。
灵魂剧震！
关于五行轮转、金锋锐利、木之生机、水之绵长、火之爆裂、土之厚重……
无数精妙的剑招变化、力量运用、气机牵引的奥义。
如同汹涌的洪流，瞬间冲刷、烙印进他意识的最深处！
仿佛他早已演练了这剑法千百万遍，每一个变招，每一分力道都成了刻入骨髓的本能！
紧接着，是更为浩瀚繁杂的丹道知识——
数以千计的灵药形态、特性、药性相生相克；
精准到毫厘的控火时机、灵力渗透的强弱节奏、药液提纯融合的微妙平衡；
低阶丹药的各种基础丹方、成型时机的把握、丹纹凝练的窍门……
所有属于《丹经·第一卷》的精华，如同醍醐灌顶，瞬间充盈了他的识海！
这一刻，他感觉自己就是浸淫丹道数十年的老手！
两股圆满级的知识洪流在脑海中奔腾激荡。
让姚德龙枯瘦的身体都抑制不住地微微颤抖。
眼中爆发出慑人的精光，仿佛两盏灿烂的光烛在黑暗中燃烧！
“哈哈哈！”
他忍不住大笑出声，笑声嘶哑却充满了前所未有的畅快和自信！
他猛地推开吱呀作响的破木门，冲入洒满月光的庭院。
content_en:
In the hut, the weak light of the oil lamp shone on Yao Delong's thin face, with a trace of determination and excitement intertwined on his face.
40 points of yin and yang are the remaining points awarded by the system after last night's madness, and they are the capital for his turnaround!
"Can't bear to let the child trap the wolf? I have never been a wolf in my life!"
He growled in his heart and pointed at the system panel crazily!
"System!
Give me a boost!
"Five Elements Basic Sword Technique"!
"Alchemy Book Volume One"!
Everything is perfect! "
[Ding!
Consume 12 yin and yang points!
["Five Elements Basic Sword Technique" (Mid-level Yellow Level) has been upgraded to: Perfect!
【bite!
Consume 15 points of yin and yang!
["The Book of Alchemy·Volume 1" (Huang Rank High Grade) has been upgraded to: Perfection!
Two dazzling runes condensed out of thin air, and with a mysterious and indescribable aura, they flew into Yao Delong's eyebrows.
"Boom——!"
The soul is shaken!
About the rotation of the five elements, the sharpness of gold, the vitality of wood, the longevity of water, the bursting of fire, the thickness of earth...
There are countless subtle changes in sword moves, the use of power, and the secrets of qi pulling.
Like a raging torrent, it instantly washed away and was imprinted into the deepest part of his consciousness!
It was as if he had practiced this sword technique millions of times, and every move and every bit of strength had become an instinct engraved in his bones!
Immediately afterwards, there is even more vast and complicated knowledge of alchemy——
Thousands of elixirs have mutually reinforcing forms, properties, and medicinal properties;
The precise timing of fire control, the strong and weak rhythm of spiritual penetration, and the delicate balance of purification and fusion of medicinal liquids;
Various basic elixir recipes for low-level elixirs, grasping the timing of formation, and tips for condensing elixir patterns...
All the essence belonging to "The Alchemy Sutra Volume 1" was like an enlightenment, instantly filling his sea of consciousness!
At this moment, he felt like he was a veteran who had been immersed in alchemy for decades!
Two torrents of perfection-level knowledge surged in his mind.
Yao Delong's skinny body couldn't help but tremble slightly.
A stunning light burst out from his eyes, as if two brilliant candles were burning in the darkness!
"Hahaha!"
He couldn't help laughing out loud, his laughter was hoarse but full of unprecedented joy and confidence!
He pushed open the creaking broken wooden door and rushed into the moonlit courtyard.
title_en: Chapter 7 Ways to Make Money Chapter 8 If you want to get rich, practice alchemy first
